issue.title: SFTPHook concurrent workers ignore the parent hook's constructor overrides
issue.body:
`SFTPHook` builds its concurrent worker hooks (`providers/sftp/src/airflow/providers/sftp/hooks/sftp.py`, the two `SFTPHook(ssh_conn_id=self.ssh_conn_id, ...)` calls used by the multi-worker download/upload paths) from `ssh_conn_id` alone. Any settings the parent hook received through its constructor — `remote_host`, `port`, `username`, password / key file, proxy configuration and other overrides — are not passed on, so the workers connect with the connection's defaults instead.

For example, a directory can be listed through a parent hook created with an explicit `remote_host`, after which the workers download the files from the connection's original host.

A regression test could patch worker-hook construction, configure the parent with a different `remote_host` (and port/username), and assert that every worker receives the parent's effective settings.

Reported by @shubhamraj-git in review of #73419.
